paragraphs: Chapter 863
Episode 215. Reunion with a God (4)
Jin decided to take on Tuzad.
Among the five priests of the Sun God religion, he was clearly the strongest warrior.
"Then I'll take care of the seniors from the Yuron and Cungen families. Luntia, you handle the seniors from the Typoon and Mayer families."
"Okay."
"Wait, what about me?"
"Murakan, you can watch over while protecting Paitel and our companions. We'll handle everything."
"Alright. If there's a problem, I'll help out then."
The riders shook their heads as if that wouldn't happen.

The priests of the Sun God religion were clearly warriors who once ruled the world. In the case of Tuzad Attila, he was famous for being the world's best swordsman at the time, and the others were all legendary experts who have been talked about until now.
However, none of them were objectively evaluated as 'prodigies'.
Therefore, Jin and the riders didn't even consider defeat. They were confident that unless they were prodigies, no one could beat them.
Jin attacked Tuzad, exerting his domination. At the same time, Jin emitted a thunderous aura in all directions, forcing the nearby priests to step back.

Luna and Luntia also engaged with their designated opponents. Jin and Tuzad were in the middle of the battlefield, Luna was on the right with Kaiman and Cungen, and Luntia was on the left with Luzin and Jin.
Screech-!
A gleam appeared in the eyes of Tuzad, who had drawn his sword, Sigmund. He wore a smile full of madness, as if he had been waiting for this kind of fight all along.
'He seems to be a type addicted to the joy of fighting itself, he's lost his mind.'
As shown when he reprimanded Jin for talking too much, Tuzad did not say a word and focused on the fight.
[Even though you've been calling me senior, you've got no manners. You pick your opponent without even asking for our consent. I was curious about that guy's blood.]
Trax looked at Luna and Jin alternately and spoke.
Luna let out a derisive laugh as if she couldn't believe it.
"You think you're something because I called you senior, you trash. Who the hell do you think you are?"
Shush-!
The axe-sword Krantel charged towards Trax's head. The moment Trax raised his sword to defend, Krantel turned its direction with an agility and speed that was unbelievable for such a massive weapon.
Trax reacted once more, but a long wound was left on his cheek. If Kaiman hadn't intervened, Trax would have been immediately overwhelmed.
"The senior treatment is over now. The good old days are gone. Both of you brace yourselves and come at me. If you want to live for a few more minutes, that is."
As Luna gathered his energy, the nearby spaces distorted and caused fractures. The rushing storm and lightning thunder could not reach Luna and were deflected.
[This crazy... Should we have retreated as he said? Kaiman, do you think we should back down to Tuzad even now?]
Kaiman didn't have the luxury to answer. Luna was already swinging her axe-sword, ready to tear him apart.
[...They're being pushed back from the start by just one person?]
Luzin and Jin had a hard time hiding their surprise. Both Kaiman and Trax were 10 stars, and among them, they were known to be close to prodigies in their time.
[I heard that no one except Chiron Runcandel has reached the level of a prodigy, but this gap is...]
"Don't you understand?"
Luntia lightly swung the triple sword Sharl in the air. Just doing that made a wave-like aura spread all around on the sword spirit.

"I've had many moments where I felt the same way watching my sister. But you guys, you're going to have the same thoughts facing me now. How can one be so strong without being a prodigy? That's the kind of thought."
As soon as her words ended, the triple sword Sharl pierced Luzin's chest. As soon as Luzin knocked Sharl away with his gauntlet, he couldn't help but calculate his own limits in his head.
'At most 50 times... I can't block more than that!'
Luzin had never experienced an opponent who could break him within such a defensive range. Even if they were a prodigy knight, he had thought it wouldn't be possible.
Especially if they were the same '10 stars'.
Jin also felt his own limit while blocking the triple sword, just like Luzin. Even though it wasn't a blow with all his might, Luntia was just swinging her sword with an expressionless face.
"Is it difficult to accept that there is such a stark difference between the same 10 stars?"
[Huff!]
"Oh, don't have the leisure to answer? Anyway, to explain the difference, you guys lived in a rather soft time. The era we are struggling in is truly the worst of all times...."
The thousand-year war between Runcandel and Zipple had reached its peak.
Each faction, as if they had made a pact, had figures who were the strongest in history, or close to it, at this current time.
In Runcandel, there was Chiron; in Zipple, Kelliark; in the Empire, Ron; in Bighung, Tallaris; in Kinzelo, Orgal.
Moreover, the next generations following them were also ascending to their ranks.
The 'demon stone' had been present since the beginning when Jin began to play a significant role, and the war among the massive forces woke up the king of the Black Sea.
There was the birth of evil gods, and underground forces and the demonic world were threatening the surface.
As Luntia said, this was the era with the most danger and obstacles since the beginning of human history.

"We've survived so far by breaking through this terrible era that's still ongoing numerous times. But we couldn't possibly be the same 10 stars, right? Did you happen to believe you could defeat a god because you had cornered Paitel? According to our master, he's not even a god-like god."
Paitel, who had been listening, glared at Luntia as he felt a momentary surge of anger.
But before Luntia felt his gaze and turned around, he had already diverted his gaze with a deflated spirit.

'Are they really human? They're like monsters...! Ah, I've used the seal so I can't break the oath, and I can't be careless. How much are these kids going to boss me around? Dammit, it's better than being annihilated by the Tuzad gang.'
Murakan looked at Paitel like that and grinned.
"Your Excellency, the sound of your grinding teeth is too loud. You should be grateful first since you survived thanks to us. Right?"
[Murakan.....]

"Think of this as fate too. Our first meeting wasn't very pleasant, but now we just have to build a beautiful relationship, right? Hahaha, from now on it's up to you. How reassuring is it with the kid and those guys? But we're not here to save you, imagine if we tried to kill you."
Paitel felt chills all over his body as he momentarily imagined that situation. He had already been completely defeated in the Green Snake Army before Jin became this strong.
[That's... I see. Thank you.]
"By the way, why were you hiding here, leaving the healthy contractors alone? Did you know they were after you from the beginning?"
[...Because of Zipple's god hunting.]
Zipple had been capturing gods for a long time to complete the demon stone. Paitel, being a high-ranking god, naturally became part of Zipple's hunting priorities.
["I didn't want to be caught by them, so I hid, but how on earth did they find out I was here?"]

"There's a shaman in the Solar Theology. He was the one who did it. He brought those specters too. If it weren't for us, you would have been helpless. By the way, why is a supposed high-ranking deity so weak? You can't even beat them at that level."

[You know, so why ask? For a deity to use all its inherent power in the human world, there are many conditions. Moreover, this isn't my domain in the first place, it's the damned tomb of my brother. There were many more constraints because I had to imitate my brother's energy.]
"Thunder God Gram, he really was amazing. Even he couldn't handle the Muyeong clan's death god. But is the leftover energy of Gram in here that strong?"
[…About ten minutes ago, my dead brother's obsession was in a very fierce state. But then they brought out some object and absorbed most of the energy. It seemed compatible with the Magic Stone.]
"Absorption?"

[Yes, probably they gathered it to use it as an ingredient for the Magic Stone. Frankly, my brother was arrogant but a great deity, so even his residual obsession would be a better material than an average deity. It was because of his obsession that you were helped when Jin Runcandel and you defeated me.]
"Even without that, you were no match for me. Hmm, then we should recover that energy after beating those guys."
By the time Murakan and Paytel had this conversation, the fight between Jin and his knights was almost decided.
[Cough, pant…!]
[Yeah, we should have fled earlier!]
Kaiman and Trax, who Luna had fought, were panting and each had lost a limb, and Lujin and Jin were making their last struggle with their fists completely crushed.
Tujaado also had wounds all over his body.
However, he wasn't the one who was driven to the defensive, he had a face that seemed to be so delighted that he might go crazy.
[Joining the Solar Theology and my wish was only one. It was such a fun fight. I have no regrets even if I perish here.]
"Senior Tujaado, you are quite insane. Did you fight only for fun even when you were alive?"
[Isn't it natural since there is no greater pleasure than this?]
"It seems you've had enough fun, so I'll let you go now."
At those words, Tujaado took out a sphere from his pocket. It was exactly the thing Paytel mentioned.
[Tujaado! Are you planning to use that!? No, if you ruin that too, we all won't be able to achieve immortality!]
Trax, who was being beaten by Luna, cried out in fear. Tujaado did not even reply to Trax's words, and he met Jin's eyes with a grin.
[I give up the promised immortality for the pleasure of this moment, Jin Runcandel. So show me more of the swords you haven't used yet.]
Tujaado shoved the sphere into his chest. Gram's energy was flickering in the sphere.
